quote_mismatches.quote: The Hyper-MUCHFUSS survey aims at finding high-velocity potentially unbound hot subdwarf stars.
The sdB star SDSS J123137.56+074621.7 (J1231) and the He-sdO star SDSS J205030.39−061957.8 (J2050) have been discovered as new objects with extreme kinematics (Geier et al. 2015b).
follow-up analysis of two known hot subdwarfs from the first Hyper-MUCHFUSS campaign as well as two new ones with extreme kinematics
The Hyper-MUCHFUSS project was started with the aim to find potentially unbound hot subdwarfs.
SDSS J163213.05+205124.0 (J1632) and SDSS J164419.44+452326.7 (J1644) have previously been investigated by Tillich et al. (2011) and are now revisited here.
